user.title: FlinQ Orion
user.description: Add a lamp without resetting it. A lamp of a configured mesh network is added to that network. Otherwise a new network is created: set its existing mesh keys in Options. Without keys the integration stays in observation mode.

add_lamp.title: Add lamp to network
add_lamp.description: Lamp {address} belongs to the mesh network {network}. Add it to this network?

abort.lamp_added: The lamp was added to the network {network}
abort.not_in_network: The device does not belong to a configured mesh network
abort.not_identified: The device cannot be identified as a FlinQ Orion lamp; add it manually

user.title: Add lamp
user.description: Select a nearby lamp or enter its Bluetooth address. 'This network' means the lamp advertises the Network ID of these keys. A lamp with a low battery advertises only Node Identity and shows 'network not verified'. The mesh address is detected on the first connection.

reconfigure.title: Lamp settings
reconfigure.description: Mesh address 0 means: detect it on the next connection. The DeviceKey is optional and is only used for composition data and model binding.

error.invalid_node: The lamp address must differ from the controller address

init.title: Mesh network
init.description: Choose observe for passive diagnostics, query_only for reads, vendor_dp for experimental Tuya DP control or sig for SIG light models. Use existing keys and a dedicated unused unicast controller address (decimal input). Confirm this address has never been used by Smart Life or another controller. Keys are stored locally in HA config entry storage, without additional encryption; protect backups. Import: select the existing entry and submit; keys and metadata are prefilled locally, and the mesh address and DeviceKey are stored with that lamp. The original integration is unchanged. Previous controller address: {previous_source}; do not reuse it. A dedicated unused address is still required.

data.connection_mode: Connection mode (on_demand: connect per command, recommended for the battery lamp; persistent: keep a link open)
data.new_source_confirmed: I confirm the controller address is unique and has never previously been used
data.import_entry_id: Import existing mesh credentials from Tuya BLE Mesh (optional)

profile.title: Confirmed light metadata
profile.description: Leave unknown settings disabled. Without confirmed endpoints, colour temperature uses 2000–6500 K, the range Home Assistant's Tuya integration used for this lamp. HSV must use the 12-hex-character format. Scene replay sends only previously received DP6 values.

data.ct_range_confirmed: Linear Kelvin mapping and CT endpoints are confirmed

error.invalid_source: Choose a valid dedicated unicast address distinct from the lamps
error.confirm_unique_source: Confirm the controller address has never been used
error.import_missing_keys: Selected entry has no valid existing SIG Mesh keys
error.import_invalid_metadata: Mesh address or IV Index is missing or invalid in the existing entry
error.import_wrong_device: Select the Tuya BLE Mesh entry of a lamp in this network
error.import_network_mismatch: The NetKey does not match the received mesh identity or beacon
error.import_iv_mismatch: Stored IV Index differs from the authenticated beacon; recovery is required
